projects.title: Multimodal RAG System
projects.description: Advanced retrieval-augmented generation system that combines text, image, and audio modalities for enhanced knowledge retrieval and generation.
projects.longDescription: Developed a cutting-edge multimodal RAG system that integrates text, image, and audio processing capabilities. The system uses graph-based knowledge representation and advanced retrieval techniques to provide contextually relevant responses across multiple modalities.

projects.title: Mechanistic Interpretability Framework
projects.description: Framework for analyzing and understanding the internal mechanisms of large language models through interpretability techniques.
projects.longDescription: Built a comprehensive framework for mechanistic interpretability of transformer-based language models. Includes tools for attention visualization, neuron analysis, and circuit discovery to understand model behavior and decision-making processes.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Conversation System
projects.description: Intelligent multi-agent system for natural conversations with specialized agents handling different domains and tasks.
projects.longDescription: Developed a sophisticated multi-agent conversation system where specialized AI agents collaborate to handle complex queries. Each agent has domain expertise and can coordinate with others to provide comprehensive responses.

projects.title: Speech-to-Text Enhancement
projects.description: Advanced speech recognition system with noise reduction and speaker identification capabilities.
projects.longDescription: Implemented an enhanced speech-to-text system that incorporates noise reduction, speaker identification, and domain adaptation. The system achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging audio datasets.

projects.title: Graph-Based Knowledge Retrieval
projects.description: Knowledge retrieval system using graph neural networks for complex query understanding and information extraction.
projects.longDescription: Built a graph-based knowledge retrieval system that leverages graph neural networks to understand complex queries and extract relevant information from knowledge graphs. The system supports both structured and unstructured data sources.
